text.description_html:
Ives MB1 Mounting Bracket for Stop Widths Over 2-1/2 Inches

Allows stop mounted hardware to be properly installed without damaging the COR coordinator, such as a parallel arm closer or a non-fire-rated surface vertical rod strike. Stop mounted hardware will need to be lowered to compensate for the height of the coordinator and mounting bracket.

Features and Specifications of the Mounting Bracket:

  • Material: Aluminum
  • Width: 4"
  • Height: 15/16"
  • Depth: 3"
  • Jamb Depth: 4-3/4" Min.
  • Stop Width: Over 2-1/2"

Sold Individually
